text:
alex_ml: Quick pulse — acceptance gate for horizon-7b-open is scheduled for tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need: licensing signoff, perf profile, CR reviews (runtime + quant), and a canary plan. Owners: @tara_curation, @ryan_legal, @kim_perf. Any blockers?

tara_curation: I pulled the curation checklist, most fields filled. Still missing license_url and provenance blob. Can someone paste the SPDX or license text?

ryan_legal: Looking now. Preliminary: model uses Apache-2.0 weights but has third-party tokenizer with MIT. Need tokenizers' NOTICE file. If we get the NOTICE by EOD I can clear license.

kim_perf: Benchmarks from staging node (A10G) after fp16 quant: 14.8 ms/token median, 98th 36 ms for 1k seq with batch=4. Memory nice. Attaching short trace:```
> seq=1024 batch=4
> median=14.8ms tok
> p98=36ms tok
> throughput=260 tok/s
```

samira_pm: Nice. Can we push one more run with kv-cache warm (prefix cache) and batch=8? We saw big tail impact on real traffic.

kim_perf: Will run now. Rough numbers after warm cache & batch=8: median 11.6 ms/token, p98 28 ms, throughput ~380 tok/s. Dropped p95 by ~20%.

alex_ml: Great. Runtime CR is still waiting — @tara_curation do we have the CR link for model manifest + quant params?

tara_curation: CR: https://git.internal/redwood/models/horizon-7b-open/merge-req/412 — added manifest, quant profile, and small inference example. Needs runtime + infra review.

alex_ml: @deploy-bot can we schedule a canary for 25% traffic on dedicated tomorrow after gate? If infra is green we fall back to 10% and monitor.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 2026-03-18T11:30:00Z -> rollout windows: 30m health-checks; alerts wired to #eng-sre.

ryan_legal: One outstanding: tokenizer NOTICE. Tara — can you grab the NOTICE and drop it in the manifest as license_attribution field? If not, legal will need the repo link.

tara_curation: On it, pinged upstream author. If I don't get it by 17:00 PT I'll add a TODO with link and tag legal for follow-up.

kim_perf: Small runtime ask: quant params in CR use per-channel symmetric, we saw slightly better perf with per-tensor for the head layers. I left a comment on the CR with numbers. Runtime team please weigh in — switching profile is a quick change but we need to re-run a canary.

alex_ml: Runtime folks (cc @kim_perf) — please review CR today. If accepted, we'll plan the canary change in the same window; otherwise we delay.

samira_pm: Blocking tracker updated: horizon-7b-open -> license: in-progress, perf: ready, CR: in-review, canary: scheduled. I'll send an async readout at 09:30 PT.

ryan_legal: If license clears, I'm good to approve. No export issues flagged.

tara_curation: NOTICE received, added to manifest at commit ab3f2c. Pushed a small update to CR.

kim_perf: final perf run with new quant variant attached to CR. p98 improved by ~6%.

alex_ml: Thanks team. Action items: 1) runtime review CR by EOD (runtime); 2) legal signoff once manifest includes NOTICE (ryan_legal); 3) infra double-check canary hooks (eng-infra). Sync message 09:30 PT from @samira_pm, gate decision at 10:30 PT.

samira_pm: copied into calendar. :white_check_mark:

ryan_legal: will sign off after quick audit.

kim_perf: will monitor canary metrics.

alex_ml: Closing thread — will post final gate result in channel and update tracker. Thanks all.
